waiting room— Tap Dance City was dancing 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'm just doing a light dance for 
image training.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Amid the surging waves of the race, I 
match the rhythm and carve out my steps—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hot! Fast! Wild! That's how we ride the 
waves to reach the treasure known as 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes... The image is taking shape...!
